summary: Allow documentation readers to manage their shared account profile without organization onboarding.
userImpact: The documentation user icon opens the existing account service for first/last-name updates without creating a tenant.

changes: PATCH /api/auth/me admits verified active managed Cloud account sessions for name changes; documentation tokens cannot update profiles.

security: Account edits retain exact live-session validation, standard browser XSRF checks, rate limiting, bounded name fields and audit logging. No documentation credential is sent through the account redirect.
knownLimitations: The matching account-service release must be deployed before the documentation profile link can be enabled in a deployed portal.
rollback: Revert the account profile entry and profile middleware change together; no data migration is required.
validation: Focused authentication and shared-account tests; exact-source gateway, profile persistence and customer isolation on disposable PostgreSQL; Chromium, Firefox and WebKit sign-in/profile checks; frontend build/typecheck and route guards.
